## Context

Strictly-derived repair from Goal #59 deployment v0.2.0. The immutable tag was correctly created for merge b6ffc8b29009c0480d2af8fb767c91a78bc01cd3, but the Burrito workflow rejected it because elixir/mix.exs still declares 0.0.1. User authorized consolidation and production deployment; preserve v0.2.0 as failed evidence and create a new patch release.

## Expected outcome

Symphony main contains version 0.2.1, the full QA suite passes, v0.2.1 produces all Burrito assets and the exact released binary is installed and verified on X1.

## Scope

- Bump elixir/mix.exs version to 0.2.1
- Run make -C elixir all
- Merge via reviewed GitHub PR
- Create immutable v0.2.1 release and verify assets
- Install and verify exact linux_x86_64 artifact on X1

## Out of scope

- Moving or deleting v0.2.0
- Unrelated Symphony changes

## Acceptance criteria

- mix.exs declares 0.2.1 on main
- Complete Symphony QA passes
- v0.2.1 Burrito workflow succeeds with four target assets and checksums
- Exact v0.2.1 linux_x86_64 binary runs on X1
- BOS deployment verification and release evidence are recorded
